description: Run Monte Carlo simulation on a portfolio to model the distribution of future returns, including percentile outcomes and probability of loss.

horizon_days.description: Simulation horizon in trading days. 21 ≈ 1 month, 63 ≈ 1 quarter, 252 ≈ 1 year. Default: 21.

lookback_days.description: Historical window used to estimate drift and volatility parameters. Range: 30-1260 trading days. Default: 252.

model.description: Stochastic process model. "gbm" = Geometric Brownian Motion (standard), "jump_diffusion" = adds jump risk for fat-tail scenarios. Default: "gbm".

num_paths.description: Number of simulation paths to run. More paths = more accurate but slower. Free tier: max 1,000. Paid tier: up to 100,000. Default: 10,000.

positions.description: Array of portfolio positions. Free tier: max 20 positions. Paid tier: up to 500.

cost_basis.description: Per-share cost basis in USD. Optional — used only for P&L calculations.

quantity.description: Number of shares held. Use a negative value to represent a short position.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL or MSFT. Must be uppercase, 1-10 characters.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Omit for a fresh random run each time.

name: monte_carlo_simulation
